notes.title: v1.4 - The Good Christian Boy Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]HAPPY HALLOWEN, OH YE FAITHFUL[/b][/h3]

[h3][i]And what would Halloween be without a reason to dive back into FAITH with...[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/bf9b6b1d57e67ee0ebf1be354693217284ba1752.jpg[/img]
FEATURING... [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b], A SPECIAL[b] "NO DEMONS" MODE[/b] for people who have gotten the hardest achievement in the game and [b]MORE[/b]:

[previewyoutube=HRncwTEccWA;full][/previewyoutube]
- That's right, there's a special play mode with new art and music that is available for players who have earned the '[b]GOOD CHRISTIAN BOY[/b]' achievement and you can now also disable demons from the Options menu. Finally a video game achievement that's as rewarding as going to church!

- [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b] is available after finding the good endings in Chapters I/II/III and finishing the Chapter 2 Prologue. Fight your way through a brand new environment encountering [i]every[/i] demon we can throw at you. Finishing a Survival run earns you one of ten ranks!

- We've added [b]FOUR new animated cutscenes[/b]. Wowza.

- There's a [b]new unlockable background[/b] by @DragonRoIlZ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/75c6d9b89e600b626981b2e3695e66ea302d9d5c.png[/img]

- The new [b]Survival Mode music track “Airdorf Medley” by Gavin Craum added to Soundtrack[/b]

- There's [b]TWO new Steam achievements[/b] related to Survival mode

- And a[b] new image added to production notebook archive[/b] in goodies. Neat.

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Game window remembers the window size % when enabling/disabling full screen
[*] Numerous fixes for issues related to cultists that transform into hideous tentacle creatures, particularly in rooms with multiple instances of these enemies
[*] Fixed moments where controller rumble won’t stop rumbling (rumbling can always be canceled by pausing)
[*] Pausing the game while in Turbo mode returns the game to normal speed to make menu navigation easier
[/list]
[b][Gameplay Adjustments][/b]
[list]
[*] Quitting the game now takes you to the Airdorf Games splash screen instead of putting you through the “bootup”/”LOADING HYMNS” screen again
[*] Reduced Alu boss’ hp by 25%
[*] Slightly reduced hp and movement speed of the secret DUSK enemy in Garyland
[*] (Survival only) Gary’s RAIN OF SPIDERS attack has a ⅛ chance of reading “AUSTRALIA”
[*] NOTE ABOUT FAITH: DEMON SIEGE - This is a fan game made by CrackedGhostGames. Any issues/questions/complaints about the game should be directed to the developer!
[/list]
[h3][i]Thanks for playing and remember...[/i][/h3]

[h3][b]GARY STILL LOVES YOU <3[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/
